notes.title: New update released
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I've just published a new update. 

It includes the latest engine version and also now you can select an option to include the engine sourcecode into your project in case you also want to modify the engine code to fit your projects needs.

Kind regards

notes.title: Spring Update released
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I have just published a small update.

Changes include:
[list]
[*]New movement type (does not depend on the rotation)
[*]Save game menu entry in main menu
[*]Dormancy indicator to indicate if an entity shall be included in dormancy checks
[*]Improved APIFuncs::ShouldDraw() engine function
[/list]

You will need to upgrade your current IScriptedEntity classes and add the CanBeDormant() method:
[code]
bool CanBeDormant()
{
	return false; //False = not included in dormancy checks, true = included in checks
}
[/code]

Dormancy checks will lead to that entities which are way out of the players range will be suspended to save processing time. However this is not suggested for every type of entity. It actually depends on what entity you are implementing.

Have fun with the update!

notes.title: Small patch & future map editor
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I've just published a small patch.

Changes:
[list]
[*]Try-Again button of ingame menu does now actually restart the match of current level
[*]Fixed that main menu is not clickable when an ingame menu is displayed in the background
[*]There is a CVar now for ingame music toggle (snd_playmusic 0/1). You can use this to determine if your game shall play music audio.
[/list]

Today I've began to create a map editor in order to conveniently design your maps. However it will take some time until a first version is finished. I will keep you updated.

Kind regards

notes.title: Urgent Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I have released an urgent hotfix.

Unfortunately it was possible to not specify a valid project name, which could lead, for instance, your project files be stored into your Desktop. If you then delete a project, it would try to delete your Desktop directory...

This security issue should now have been fixed.

If you still encounter any problems, please reply here or create a forum discussion.

Kind regards

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
A small patch has been published.

You can now use the API to loop sounds (especially suited if you want to have some background theme music), stop currently played sounds, and also trigger the game saving process programmatically. 

I am still planning to create a map editor, but this will take some time, so stay tuned!

Happy Weekend!

notes.title: Early access Halloween release
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Casual Game Engine is now available for early access usage. 

I hope that you have much fun with the product and please feel free to report bugs in the discussion section.

In future I am also planning to create a map editor, so you do not have to modify map files via a text editor. I am currently evaluating how the map editor shall be implemented. Of course any update will be posted.

Kind regards and happy halloween!

notes.title: First version is almost done!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

good news! The product is almost in a good first version state! This means that the game engine first version is done. There will be a builder GUI to create games based upon the engine. This builder GUI is almost done. Last thing is the documentation, which still needs some more progress. For the documentation there will be a GitHub page where you can view all neccessary information to create a game using the engine. I will also create a tutorial video which will introduce and cover game development using the engine.

When these all things are done, I will then submit the bundle to Steam for approval. I am very certain that an initial release will happen even this month!

Kind regards
